attacks.claim: Smart Send Time builds a per-subscriber behavioural profile from 90 days of open history and turns it on by default for every publication, but the artifact specifies no subscriber notice, lawful basis, or subscriber-side opt-out. Publishers can disable it, but the readers being profiled cannot.
attacks.evidence: "Inkwell predicts each subscriber's most likely open hour from their last 90 days of opens... Enabled by default for all publications; publishers can turn it off in Settings → Delivery." ABSENT: any subscriber disclosure, consent or opt-out mechanism, or privacy/legal review of per-recipient open-time profiling.
